SELECT operate_log.id, COALESCE(operate_log.subject_account, operate_log.actor_account) AS login_code, operate_log.actor_name AS login_name, operate_log.module, operate_log.title, operate_log.resource, operate_log.ip, operate_log.type, operate_log.exception, operate_log.create_time FROM operate_log
operate_log.is_delete = 0 AND operate_log.event_type = 'AUTHENTICATION'
AND operate_log.create_time >= #{req.startTime}
AND operate_log.create_time <= #{req.endTime}
AND COALESCE(operate_log.subject_account, operate_log.actor_account) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.loginCode}, '%')
AND operate_log.actor_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.loginName}, '%')
AND operate_log.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{req.title}, '%')
ORDER BY operate_log.id DESC
